messages:
Sasha M: Quick flag  I found a handful of structured-output examples that changed shape after the invoke rename. Some examples now return an envelope (e.g. {result: {...}}) while the JSON Schema snippets in the reference assume the raw object. That will trip strict validators.

Ivy K: Oof. Which pages are impacted?

Sasha M: Found them in /docs/guides/invoke/quickstart and /docs/reference/structured-output.md. Also one example repo link points at a deleted branch.

Alex M: Thanks. Plan: 1) patch broken links to canonical main branch, 2) add a short migration note in the invoke guide, 3) add a small docs-only parse helper and dual-schema examples so `additionalProperties: false` can stay.

Ivy K: Agreed. Suggest we show both shapes side-by-side in the schema section: "raw result" schema and "enveloped result" schema, plus a one-line unbox helper. Example JS snippet: `const unbox = v => (v && v.result) ? v.result : v;` Mark it as temporary.

Sasha M: Also add a tiny Python helper for parity: `def unbox(x): return x.get('result', x) if isinstance(x, dict) else x`

Alex M: I'll open a single PR bundling link fixes, the dual-schema examples, the JS/Python unbox snippets, and a short example-harness test that runs unbox before AJV/pykwalify validation. PR body will reference this thread.

redwood-docs-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1755 checks: link-check queued, lint queued

Ivy K: Wording nit: avoid saying "deprecated" when referencing old helper names in user-facing text. Use "previous helper names" and document the migration steps.

Alex M: Good point, will update copy. Also adding an inline comment above the unbox helper: `// compat shim for docs only; TODO remove after snippets migrated (tracking: #1780)`

redwood-docs-bot: CI update for PR #1755: link-check passed, lint passed, examples-harness showed 1 failing test (missing sample file path). See CI logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/teams/docs/runs/5890

Sasha M: I'll fix the sample file path and push a commit.

Alex M: Fixed and re-ran CI. All checks green. Marking PR ready for review and assigning to @Ivy K and @Sasha M.

Ivy K: Reviewed, left a tiny wording tweak. Approving after nit.

Alex M: Merged PR #1755. Follow-up: I'll create tracking issue #1780 and schedule a sweep in two weeks to remove the docs-only helper once all snippets are migrated.

Sasha M: Great. Added a short CHANGELOG entry and updated the top of the invoke guide with a note: "If you use our code samples, run `yarn docs:test-examples` locally to validate link and schema shapes."

redwood-docs-bot: PR #1755 merged to main. Release note: docs: handle invoke envelope in structured-output examples; add temporary unbox helpers and migration notes.

Alex M: Thanks everyone  closing thread.
